svg.metadata:
Font name: Consolines Format: SVG 1.1 single-line font Source: holden_consolines_font/sketch.js Original font: Consolines, a monospace single-line font by Daniel Holden, 2025. The letterforms are roughly based on Consolas by Luc de Groot.
Reference: https://theorangeduck.com/page/debug-draw-text-lines
The source font contains line segments for 95 printable ASCII characters, starting with ! and ending with ~. Line segments are packed into 32-bit integers containing the four 8-bit coordinates start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y.
